notes: Implemented Phase 1 of the follow-up plan: CR-FU-04 (Saliency Failure Toast) and CR-FU-06 (Keyboard Shortcut Discoverability). Added shared toast notification system with reactive state, showToast() method, template element with ARIA live region, and CSS styles. Wired saliency analyzer createSaliencyAnalyzer into Vue lifecycle with onModelsFailed callback that shows info toast. Added keyboard shortcut hint below layout controls. Addressed world-review concerns: (1) fixed ARIA conflict by using role=status instead of role=alert, (2) added aria-hidden=true to decorative icon, (3) added toast timer cleanup in beforeUnmount, (4) increased z-index to 9999, (5) added mobile safe-area support with env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Updated plan status to In Progress.
